Software domains, by industry.

Open any card to see what the work involves, what makes it hard, and how it plays out in India.

Sources & methodology

India examples are drawn from public sources — government portals and regulators (RBI, NPCI, SEBI, IRDAI, TRAI, FSSAI, BIS, CPCB, MoD) and industry bodies — and are illustrative, not exhaustive. Content last reviewed 12 October 2026. Verify specifics against the named authority before relying on them.
